title: End position is nondecreasing
statement: Let $F\in\mathbb{N}$, let $bs$ be a finite list of statements, and let $pos\in\mathbb{N}$. The end position obtained by advancing from $pos$ through the list, adding each statement's size at frame width $F$ and an epilogue of size $5$, is at least $pos$.
